description: Enhance a raw prompt with PromptArch's Prompt Enhancer: PromptArch asks 1-3 targeted clarifying questions, then rewrites the prompt from the person's answers, optimized for target_model. If this client supports MCP elicitation, the questions appear to the person as a form inside this call. Otherwise call once with just `prompt` to get the questions (free), ask the person, and call again with `questions` and `answers`. Never answer the questions yourself. The enhancement costs 5 credits; questions are free. Requires a PromptArch API key configured as an Authorization: Bearer pk_... header on this MCP server.

answers.description: Second call only: the person's own answers, keyed by question id (e.g. {"q1": "..."}).

questions.description: Second call only: the questions JSON exactly as this tool returned it.

target_model.description: The model the enhanced prompt is for (e.g. Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-5). Default: generic, no model-specific optimization.

name: promptarch_enhance_prompt
